journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-journey.md): Editing a goal never disturbs a run already under way:
a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.\n- [List swarms](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/
list-swarms.md)\n- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring conta
iner holding DEFAULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.\n- [Get a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the co
ntainer. The goals authored under it are not touched: they keep their own definitions and stay launchable.\n- [Update a swarm](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFAULTS. Goals already authored under it ke
ep the values they were created with: this is not a cascade.\n- [List journeys](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-
journeys.md): The project's goals, newest first. Archived goals are excluded.\n- [Create a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a task against one or more environments. To draft severa
l with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate`: that route persists nothing.\n- [List secrets](https://docs
.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): The project's credentials as METADATA ONLY: no value is returned by this or an
y other route. Shows the project-shared secrets plus the caller's own personal ones; another member's personal secret does not app
ear at all, not even its name.\n- [Create a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a cre
dential so environments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the call
. The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret requires project admin; a personal one does not.\n- [Get a secre
t](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One secret's metadata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, an
d when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from another project (and another member's personal secret) both rea
d as 404.\n- [Delete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/delete-a-secret.md): Delete a stored credential. HARD
: the row and the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still sele
cts it: refusing would leave a leaked credential undeletable until someone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must n
ever wai…\n- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the
value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already running holds the old value (materia
lized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy that cannot be read back) and there is no safe way to replace it mid-ru
n.\n- [List a journey's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-journeys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact rec
ords: `attempts` is on the single-run read.\n- [Launch a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journe
y.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists and its fan-out has started. It is not finished. Poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-r
uns/{runId}` until `status` leaves `running`.\n- [Get a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journe
y-run.md): The full record, including per-session `attempts` and `targetSummaries`.\n- [List a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): One entry per chat session the run produced. Summaries, not transcripts. R
ead a transcript through the chat-session routes using `id`.\n- [Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm
-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request and returns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts are
being settled in the background; status remains the current stored run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run an
swers 200 with `alreadyCanceled: true` and `finalized: 0`, not a 409.\n- [Project swarm roll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/swarm-insights/project-swarm-roll-up.md): Recent runs with their goal-completion rates and repeat-failure findings, plus a pr
oject-wide trend. Deterministic and free. Start here.\n- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swar
m-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The deterministic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.\n- [List swarm findin
gs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/list-swarm-findings.md): Criteria that keep failing, tracked across waves
. One finding is one problem OVER TIME: `occurrenceCount` and `status` carry the history, so do not treat repeat appearances as se
parate problems.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/dismiss-a-finding.md): Hides a findin
g from your view. ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing does not claim the problem stopped happening, and a dismissed finding that fi
res again stays `recurring`.\n- [Undismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/undismiss-a-finding.md)
: Reverses a dismissal. Bodyless, like its twin.\n- [Get swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/
get-swarm-run-insights.md): Poll this after requesting insights. **404 means nobody asked**: it is deliberately not an empty `stat
us: \"none\"` body, so a caller in a polling loop cannot mistake \"never requested\" for \"asked and still working\".\n- [Request
swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/request-swarm-run-insights.md): Answers **202**: generati
on is scheduled, not done. Poll the GET above rather than re-requesting.\n- [Cancel a pending swarm-run-insights generation](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/cancel-a-pending-swarm-run-insights-generation.md): Stops a generation that is sti
ll `pending`. A swarm run with no generation in progress answers 409: there is nothing to cancel, and reporting success would tell
a caller it stopped something it did not.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/reque
st-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and
draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Jud
ge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.** Runs the goal-completion judg
e over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server aga
inst Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path
names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Determinist
ic grading is…\n- [Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start
-an-openai-plugin-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against OpenAI's plugin-directory requirements and returns
`202` with a run id. `submissionMode` is required and never inferred: inferring it would read a forgotten package as `mcp-only` an
d report the package lane not-applicable, turning a missing input into a clean bill of…\n- [Start a Muse connector readiness run](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-muse-connector-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server agains
t Meta's Muse connector guidelines and returns `202` with a run id. Free: Muse readiness has no AI observations, so the body has n
o field that can spend, and no submission mode, which belongs to the OpenAI plugin directory. The submission-ready verdict stays `
